description: A new comment thread on a Drive file, as the account. `quoted` shows the text it is about beside it. Google Docs shows a comment made through the API on the file, not anchored to text (Google's limit); `anchor` is for file types whose viewer reads one. Everyone with access to the file sees it.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

anchor.description: Drive's anchor JSON, for non-Google files.

file_id.description: The file's id, or its URL.

quoted.description: The passage the comment is about.

name: add_comment
title: Comment on a file
